#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

int n, m;
vector<vector<vector<int>>> memo;

int go(int row, int col, int mask) {
    if (memo[row][col][mask] != -1) {
        return memo[row][col][mask];
    }
    if (row == m) {
        return memo[row][col][mask] = (mask == 0) ? 0 : INT_MIN;
    }
    if (col == n) {
        return memo[row][col][mask] = go(row + 1, 0, mask);
    }
    if (mask & 1) {
        return memo[row][col][mask] = go(row, col + 1, mask >> 1);
    }
    int res = go(row, col + 1, mask >> 1);
    res = max(go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (3 * n - 1))) + 2, res);
    if (col != 0 && !((mask >> (2 * n - 1)) & 1)) {
        res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (2 * n - 2))) + 2);
    }
    if (col != n - 1 && !((mask >> (2 * n + 1)) & 1)) {
        res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (2 * n))) + 2);
    }
    if (col >= 2 && !((mask >> (n - 2)) & 1)) {
        res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (n - 3))) + 2);
    }
    if (col < n - 1 && !((mask >> (n + 2)) & 1)) {
        res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (n + 1))) + 2);
    }
    memo[row][col][mask] = res;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    cin >> n >> m;
    if (n > m) {
        swap(n, m);
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        long long x = m % 6;
        if (x <= 3) {
            cout << m - x << "\n";
            return 0;
        }
        if (x == 4) {
            cout << m - 2 << "\n";
            return 0;
        }
        cout << m - 1 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (n <= 5 && m <= 30) {
        memo.assign(m + 1, vector<vector<int>>(n + 1, vector<int>(1 << (3 * n), -1)));
        cout << go(0, 0, 0) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    cout << n * m - n * m % 2 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
